description: Full-text search over received and sent mail (subject, body and addresses), newest first; every word must match. Narrows by agent, sender, recipient, date range, attachment, folder, label or direction. Each hit says whether it was `received` or `sent` and carries a snippet around the match.

after.description: Only mail at or after this time (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD).

agent_id.description: Filter by agent id or name. A key tied to one agent always reads that agent's mail, and naming another agent is a 403.

before.description: Only mail before this time (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor`.

folder.description: Which folder's mail to return, or `all` for every folder. Without it: every folder except trash.

from.description: The sender's address contains this text (the display name, which the sender chooses, is not matched).

has_attachment.description: `true` for mail with a file attachment, `false` for mail without.

label.description: Only mail in threads carrying this label (a name, or a label id `lbl_…`).

q.description: Full-text search: every word must appear in the subject, body or addresses, as a whole word or, from three letters up, the start of one (`inv` finds `invoice`). At most 16 different words (more is a 400).

to.description: A recipient address contains this text.

type.description: Only received or only sent mail.

name: mails_search_mail
title: Search mail
